# ◆ HELIOS

installer, updater and setup of the 741 environment. Planned, not built. The repository holds the plan only. Every app keeps working without HELIOS.

## ◆ STATUS

- planned. No shipped features yet.
- the plan's first step is the release feed and catalog for each app. Then a command-line core (catalog, feed check, download, verify, install, rollback), then the setup flow, shared settings, and a window.
- until HELIOS ships: each app has its own updater and setup. Stand-alone mode works without the agent.

## ◆ WHAT IT WILL DO

- create or adopt the 741 home (Drive folder or local folder), write `agent.json`, install and start `mnemo-agent` as a LaunchAgent, and check the hello reply
- hold shared settings (music library folders, streaming folder, export, backups) as `setting` records
- install, update, roll back and remove MINOS, ORPHEUS, CHARON, STYX and the agent
- install the 741 skill as a Claude plugin (optional, off by default)


# ◆ HELIOS-741 · PLAN

Native macOS app. First app of a 741 setup: creates the 741 home, installs and updates the 741 apps, holds the shared settings. Every app keeps working without HELIOS.

## ◆ SCOPE

| area | what |
|---|---|
| setup | choose home (Drive or local), create a new `collection.741` or adopt an existing one, write `agent.json`, install `mnemo-agent` as LaunchAgent |
| shared settings | settings for all 741 apps, written as MNEMOSYNE setting records |
| apps | install, update, roll back, remove: MINOS, ORPHEUS, CHARON, STYX, mnemo-agent |
| versions | channel per app, installed / available version, history, rollback |

## ◆ SETUP

- home default `My Drive/741` (D8). Options: other Drive account, any local folder, existing home.
- new home: new library id, empty `collection.741`. Existing home: read gen, schema, library id; show summary before adopting.
- writes `~/Library/Application Support/741/agent.json` (`home`, `library`, `device`). Only HELIOS and `mnemo-agent` write this file (D13).
- installs and starts `mnemo-agent` (LaunchAgent), checks hello reply (`home`, `localStore`, protocol >= 1.4).
- change of home later: stop agent, copy or move, rewrite `agent.json`, restart agent. Never live: refuse while a 741 app holds a deck loaded (`loaded` guard).

## ◆ SHARED SETTINGS

- written over the agent socket as setting records. Scope `g` (all devices) or `d:<deviceId>` (this device). Device wins over global (AGENT.md SETTINGS).
- first set: music library folders, Drive streaming folder, export (folder, NML / XML names, on/off), backups (hourly / weekly / monthly / yearly retention), default import folder.
- every setting: default value, reset, scope switch.
- app-specific settings stay in the apps. A setting moves to HELIOS only when two or more apps read it.

## ◆ APPS AND UPDATES

- catalog: `catalog.json` in the public HELIOS release repo. Per app: name, bundle id, release repo, install path, min system, needs agent y/n.
- feed per app: `latest.json` in the public `<APP>-releases` repo (format of MINOS: `version`, `build`, `file`, `sha256`, `size`, `date`, `minSystem`, `url`, `codename`). Tags: `latest-build` (rolling), `vX.Y.Z` (named).
- source code repos stay private. Every app gets a public release repo, like MINOS: `MINOS-741-releases`, `Orpheus-releases` (ORPHEUS: electron feeds `latest*.yml`, macos / windows / linux), `Charon-741-releases`, `STYX-741-releases`, `HELIOS-741-releases`.
- channel per app: newest build / stable versions / own folder / off. Default newest build.
- install: download, sha256 check, codesign check (team id), replace bundle, keep the last 3 versions for rollback.
- no update while the app runs: ask to quit, or install on next quit.
- HELIOS updates itself over the same feed.

## ◆ WITHOUT HELIOS

- every app keeps its own updater and its own setup.
- HELIOS present: HELIOS writes `managedBy: helios` per app into `<localStore>/helios.json`. The app updater reads it, shows "updates by HELIOS" and does not check itself. Option in each app: own updater anyway.
- apps without agent run as today (stand-alone mode).

## ◆ STYX

- 2026-11-10: STYX becomes a 741 app. Connect to `.741` over `MnemoClient` (library, playlists, history). Bandcamp and the existing XML / direct-write path stay. Own plan in the STYX repo.

## ◆ CLAUDE

Optional, each off by default, own switch in setup and settings.

| option | what |
|---|---|
| claude terminal | install Claude Code CLI (official installer), check `claude --version` |
| daw mcp | MCP server for the DAW: remote script into the DAW user library, `claude mcp add` entry. UI and public texts without the product name |

- 741 skill source: public repo `Slayer7411/741-claude`, built from the MNEMOSYNE docs and the app docs by `tools/build-skill.sh`. Every app release runs it, bumps the plugin version, pushes.
- skill content: `.741` format, safe write path (over the agent), features of every 741 app.

## ◆ STEPS

1. feed and catalog: `latest.json` in every release repo (ORPHEUS: read `latest-mac.yml` or add `latest.json`).
2. HELIOS core: catalog, feed check, download, verify, install, rollback. CLI first (`helios`), tests.
3. setup: home choice, `agent.json`, LaunchAgent, hello check.
4. shared settings over the socket.
5. app side: `helios.json` handover in MINOS, ORPHEUS, CHARON, STYX.
6. UI in 741-design, settings window for everything.
7. e2e with isolated homes and a local feed folder.

## ◆ OPEN

- Windows: no agent yet (MNEMOSYNE D-ts). HELIOS macOS first.
- signing: Developer ID + notarization for public builds, or development certificate as now.
- install path: `/Applications` (admin) or `~/Applications`, option.
